announcements.title: Daily Qur’an portion
announcements.content:
Remaining consistent” with your Ddaily Qur’an Portion is an achievement in itself 
it brings you satisfaction, peace, and comfort, 
and brings abundant blessings and goodness into your life.

And among the greatest losses is that your day has room for everything… except the Qur’an.

flash.content: Prophet Muhammad -peace and blessings be upon him- said: There are no days on which righteous deeds are more beloved to Allah than these ten days.
